en.headline: West Kowloon Emergency Unit officer’s service weapon discharges accidentally while loading
en.dek: One round was fired at about 11:01 p.m. on Tuesday inside the unit’s operations base; no one was injured and the force said the matter is under investigation.
body: A male officer attached to the West Kowloon Regional Emergency Unit accidentally discharged his service weapon while loading ammunition at the unit’s operations base at about 11:01 p.m. on Tuesday.

Police said one round was fired. No one was injured in the incident. The force reiterated that it has strict rules governing the use of equipment and that the matter is being followed up by the West Kowloon Regional Emergency Unit.
The incident occurred in the designated loading area of the base. Police did not release further details pending the internal inquiry.

zh.headline: 西九龍衝鋒隊男警配槍上彈走火 射出一子彈無人傷
zh.dek: 一名男警昨晚約11時01分在西九龍總區衝鋒隊行動基地上彈區為配槍入彈時意外走火，發射一發子彈，無人受傷。
body: 一名隸屬西九龍總區衝鋒隊的男警務人員於昨日（25日）晚上11時01分，在西九龍總區衝鋒隊行動基地上彈區為一支配槍入彈期間，其配槍意外走火，發射一發子彈。
事件中無人受傷。警方重申，警隊就使用裝備有嚴格的規定，事件現正由西九龍總區衝鋒隊跟進。
警方未有進一步公布詳情，內部調查仍在進行。
